_meta.notes: TYPED filing faxed to the clerk; the fax header numbers the transmission 'Page N of 7' but the PDF holds only 6 sheets. PDF page 1 is the 'Statement of Organization For a Candidate' (fax page 1) and PDF page 2 is already the Summary Page (fax page 3) — the disclosure report's COVER page (fax page 2, the form's 'page 1 of 5') IS MISSING from this PDF. Consequently report_type, is_amendment/amendment_of and political party could not be read at all and are null, not blank: the Type-of-Report box is only on that missing sheet. The candidate name and office come from the Statement of Organization ('Office: Salt Lake County Auditor'); the report date comes from the 'Date of Report' box printed on the Summary Page and schedules (4/6/2014). Clerk listing labels this the April interim, which the 4/6/2014 date and APR 07 2014 received stamp are consistent with, but the form's own checkbox could not be verified.
